scope: Proposition 8.7 (Removal of the auxiliary sampling choices) of the manuscript “The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4” (preprints/The-critical-Liouville-quantum-sphere-and-geometric-limits-of-FK-maps-at-q-equals-4-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b9236021eab20eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 151. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Given h, J, the conditional laws of the regularized true profile arrays are unchanged by revealing the central loop, associated end choices and phase, and the entire canonical source family. Conditional profile kernels for disjoint strictly buffered observations multiply given h, J.
